identity_note: Runtime headwords are positional arrays [rank, lemma, pos, ipa, [ku tuples]]; there is no headword_id field and no sense_id field anywhere in the Runtime (0 occurrences of the string sense_id). The pack's headword_id 'core20k:rank:NNN' therefore cannot be a Runtime key: it correctly encodes the rank (6/6 rank-lemma matches) but is a legacy/external identifier, not a Runtime-native ID. The pack's sense_id 'w_..._s01' likewise has no Runtime counterpart: sense ownership is established indirectly through the exact ku_id match plus gloss correspondence, NOT through an independent sense registry. The s01<->ku01 pairing rests on the shared w_ stem naming convention. A gloss-based join is FORBIDDEN as a join method: 5 of 6 headwords carry a sister KU (morphology/grammar/collocation) with identical or near-identical glosses to ku01; only the exact ku_id join is unambiguous.
